title: Recruiting & Onboarding | HR Tier | BackOfficeFleet
description: Recruiting and onboarding operating page for trucking HR teams moving candidates from intake to assignment readiness.
html:
HR Tier / Recruiting & Onboarding

Move driver and staff candidates into readiness with fewer handoff gaps.

Recruiting is not complete when an application arrives. BOF connects sourcing, screening, DQF handoff, safety acknowledgement, pay setup, training, and assignment release into a visible workflow.

HR TierDriver Onboarding

Readiness chain

Candidate interest becomes operating value only when the file can support the assignment.

Recruiting needs the same readiness language as dispatch: ready, review, blocked, owner, and next action.

Recruiting and onboarding pipeline

Move candidates from interest to first-load readiness with every handoff visible.

The pipeline shows the information a recruiter, HR owner, safety reviewer, and dispatcher need before a candidate becomes operational capacity.

LeadRCR-118 / flatbed referral

CDL-A, 3 years OTR, home base Tulsa, flatbed interest, available Aug 5.

ScreeningRCR-121 / reefer applicant

Application complete; MVR consent, prior-employment verification, and drug-screen routing pending.

DQFRCR-126 / regional dry van

Recruiter cleared interview; DQF checklist needs medical, MVR, road test, and policy handoff.

OnboardingRCR-130 / owner-operator

Contractor packet, W-9, insurance certificate, pay setup, and first-load equipment check are in progress.

First LoadRCR-133 / first-load ready

Driver file, payroll setup, training, policy acknowledgment, and dispatch release note are complete.

BlockedRCR-139 / incomplete onboarding

Candidate cannot be released because drug screen result, policy acknowledgment, and pay setup are missing.

Candidate preview

Lead: RCR-118

Lead / recruiter touch

The candidate has enough profile detail to begin screening, but BOF has not yet confirmed application completeness or operating fit.

Candidate fields
Source: driver referral; endorsements: flatbed/tanker; home base: Tulsa; availability: Aug 5.
Clearance path
Recruiter confirms application; collect CDL and medical card; schedule phone screen; move to screening if lane fit is confirmed.
BOF support lane
Track applicant source, collect documents, route DQF handoff, prepare payroll or contractor setup, and show when the candidate can support the first load.
Source
Track where the applicant entered.

Referral, ad source, recruiter, terminal, lane interest, experience profile, license class, and preferred communication path.

Candidate record
Screen
Move missing items into an owner queue.

Application gaps, prior employment questions, DQF handoff, MVR/medical card status, payroll setup, and training requirements.

Review queue
Release
Show when the candidate can be assigned.

Safety acknowledgement, equipment needs, route fit, dispatch readiness, and final office approval are visible before work is promised.

Assignment ready
